added.member: RpgHits, RpgLeader, RpgLockOn, RpgLootFeed, RpgMenuBar, RpgMinimap, RpgParty, RpgPlaceCard
added.summary: The character HUD's feedback components ship as TSX beside their component documents: same props, states, strings and accessibility, styled with Tailwind classes and the new UI's primitives. HudBar, HudPortrait and HudLootEntry have no TSX ports yet, so leader, party and loot-feed carry faithful local stand-ins to swap when they land; the lock-on's conic arcs stand in as one lit ring, the minimap draws its player arrow as a Line, and octagon clip-paths and container queries are approximated or dropped.
